description: This file defines performance benchmark tests for app startup times in an Android application, utilizing macrobenchmarking tools. It includes multiple test cases for different compilation modes and measures startup performance from a cold start state.

classes.name: StartupBenchmark
classes.description: Defines performance benchmarks for startup times of the app under various compilation modes.

methods.name: startupWithoutPreCompilation
methods.description: Measures app startup time without pre-compilation using the 'None' compilation mode.

methods.name: startupWithPartialCompilationAndDisabledBaselineProfile
methods.description: Measures startup with partial compilation mode and disabled baseline profile.

methods.name: startupPrecompiledWithBaselineProfile
methods.description: Measures startup with partial compilation mode requiring baseline profile.

methods.name: startupFullyPrecompiled
methods.description: Measures startup with full precompilation mode.

methods.name: startup
methods.description: Executes a specific startup benchmark with a given compilation mode, performing setup, launching the activity, and waiting for content readiness.
